name: Bright Passage: Life Under the Sable Charter
description: A holographic feature commissioned by the Sable Group corponation depicting daily life in their Tier 3 residential blocks as a warm, community-oriented idyll of shared purpose and corporate belonging. The film was distributed free to all Sable-controlled residential units and plays on a rotating loop in the corponation's public transit corridors. Its production values are exceptional — Sable Group hired four of Vantablack Media's top holographic directors, poaching them for the project under short-term contracts.
cultural_impact: Became an unintentional cultural meme when residents began sarcastically describing genuinely terrible situations as 'very Bright Passage,' a usage Sable Group's PR division has been unable to suppress.
story_hooks: One of the four hired directors is now trying to leak the production notes, which contain explicit instructions to digitally alter the residential blocks' actual appearance.
The 'Dark Passage' editor is still active and is working on a follow-up — they need someone to get real current footage from inside a Sable block.
A Sable Group loyalty officer has noticed that the film's approval ratings in one specific residential block have gone mysteriously flat and suspects organized non-compliance.
